settings.headline: The rules, in
settings.subtitle: Short and readable on purpose. If anything is unclear, email entries@example.com and a person will answer.

rules.title: Who can enter
rules.body:
Anyone, anywhere, over 18. Students of any age can enter the Student category with a note from their course leader.
Judges, their studios and their families cannot enter this year.

rules.title: What you can enter
rules.body:
Work made or first published between 1 July 2025 and the category deadline.
Self-initiated work is welcome in every category.

rules.title: Fees
rules.body:
Fees are listed on each category page. We confirm your entry by email first and send a payment link after that. We never take payment on this website.
Students enter for free.

rules.title: Generated images
rules.body: Work made mainly with image generators is not eligible. Tools used for small fixes are fine, as long as you mention them in your statement.

rules.title: How judging works
rules.body: Every judge scores every entry on their own, then the panel meets to agree the shortlist and awards. A judge who knows an entrant steps aside for that entry.

rules.title: Your rights
rules.body:
You keep all rights to your work. By entering, you allow us to show it in the gallery, at the ceremony and in press about the awards, always with your name.
You can ask us to remove work from the gallery at any time.

rules.title: Privacy
rules.body: We use your details only to run the awards. We never sell or share them, and we delete entry details two years after the ceremony.
